scripts.build: npm run typecheck && esbuild index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node25 --format=cjs --outfile=dist/index.cjs --minify && npm run copy-data
scripts.deploy:full: npm run build && npx tsx deploy.ts
scripts.copy-data: mkdir -p dist/data/modalities && cp -f inference/data/models.json inference/data/models_extended.json dist/data/ && cp -f inference/data/modalities/text.json dist/data/modalities/
scripts.sync-models: cd inference/scripts && npx tsx sync-alibaba.ts && npx tsx sync-asicloud.ts && npx tsx sync-azure.ts && npx tsx sync-cartesia.ts && npx tsx sync-deepgram.ts && npx tsx sync-cf.ts && npx tsx sync-deepinfra.ts && npx tsx sync-elevenlabs.ts && npx tsx sync-fireworks.ts && npx tsx sync-gemini.ts && npx tsx sync-roboflow.ts && npx tsx sync-openai.ts && npx tsx sync-models.ts && npx tsx import-models.ts
scripts.metrics: tsx metrics/cli.ts sync && tsx metrics/cli.ts snapshot
